title: Manners of 'Taqseer' of Umrah
introduction:
MANNERS OF 'TAQSEER' OF UMRAH

After completing all the rounds of sayy between Safa and Marwah, it is obligatory to cut a little hair or nails. It is better to cut a little hair along with nails as a precaution. It is not recommended to shave one's head during Umrah-e-Tamatto but is also prohibited.

It is better to recite this supplication during Taqseer:

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَعْطِنِیْ بِكُلِّ َشَعْرَۃٍ نُوْرًا یَوْمَ الْقِیَامَۃِ۔
